description: This is an __init__.py file for the torchfuzz package, which facilitates generating and testing random PyTorch operations. It primarily re-exports key classes and functions from submodules to define the public API.

classes.name: OperationGraph
classes.description: A class representing a computational graph of operations for fuzzing purposes.

classes.name: ScalarSpec
classes.description: Class defining specifications for scalar values used in fuzzing.

classes.name: Spec
classes.description: Base class for various specifications in the fuzzing framework.

classes.name: TensorSpec
classes.description: Class defining tensor specifications used in fuzzing operations.

methods.name: get_operator
methods.description: Retrieves a specific operator by name.

methods.name: register_operator
methods.description: Registers a new operator for use in the fuzzing framework.

methods.name: fuzz_operation_graph
methods.description: Generates a fuzzed operation graph for testing.

methods.name: fuzz_spec
methods.description: Creates a specification object for fuzzing.
